replication.target_description: Unresolved conflict between Study 1 identifier and page 20 Study 2 locator; subjective SES/dictator-game regression versus manipulated/measured SES and charitable donations.

notes: Identity verified independently from source cover/title: Having Less, Giving More? Two Preregistered Replications of the Relationship Between Social Class and Prosocial Behavior; Angelos Stamos, Florian Lange, Szu-chi Huang, Siegfried Dewitte; DOI 10.1016/j.jrp.2019.103902. Full accepted journal pre-proof, including methods, results, references and Tables 1–6; 2019 pre-proof corresponds to cited 2020 publication. No PDF was supplied. Only es_value_r is assigned; all other fields are placeholders. Target correspondence is unresolved: study_r=1 identifies the Stanford subjective-SES/dictator-game study (section 2.4, source form-feed page 13), but locators_r=p.20 identifies Study 2 charitable-donation results (source form-feed page 20). No neutral outcome description resolves this conflict. Study 1 candidates: focal OLS β=0.007, t(298)=0.115, p=0.91; covariate-adjusted β=0.005, t(295)=0.08, p=0.93; disbelief-excluded β=-0.001, t(247)=-0.02, p=0.98. Table 6 repeats the focal Study 1 coefficient. Page 20 candidates are distinct Study 2 tests: manipulation check d=0.65, t(198)=4.82, p<0.001; manipulated-SES charitable donations d=0.36, t(198)=2.56, p=.01; measured-SES charitable donations r=-0.02, p=0.81. The requested d does not justify selecting Study 2 over the supplied Study 1 identifier. No coefficient converted, and no target selected by numerical agreement. Candidate values retained only in notes/disposition; es.value remains null pending field-scope target review.
